concerns.text: Plan T021 (the primary FR-004 estimator) mandates 'shuffle group labels N = 5000 times' per dataset; tasks.md T006 silently reduces this to '1000 label-shuffling null replicates' (and the pilot T005 uses 2000). This is a retroactive weakening of the plan's stated precision for the core FR-004/SC-002 estimate with no documented justification or spec amendment. Reconcile to 5000 or explicitly amend the plan/spec.

Plan T023 specifies 'Bootstrap (10 000 resamples)'; T008 weakens this to '≥ 2000 resamples'. Since SC-004 measures CI half-width against ±0.02, the resample count directly affects whether the target is attainable — the task relaxes the plan's constraint while claiming SC-004 coverage. Align to 10,000 or document the change in the plan.

T005/T006/T007 introduce an untransformed 'baseline' condition (T005's pass criterion even depends on it), but both the aggregated_result and transformation schemas have transformation enums of only box_cox/yeo_johnson/rank_based with additionalProperties:false. Baseline results are produced but cannot be represented in any contract-conformant output, and T008's '12 rows (3 × 2 × 2)' verification contradicts the 4-condition data actually generated. Either extend the contracts or drop the baseline.

aggregated_result.schema.yaml has no effect_size field (additionalProperties: false), so T008's aggregated_results.csv cannot represent power per effect size as FR-006/FR-007 require ('for each transformation-test-effect combination'), yet T010's power_curves.png requires 'power vs. effect size per transformation/test'. Specify that T010 reads T007's per-effect JSONs, or extend the schema — as written the task deliverable falls short of the FR it tags.

α-sweep grid disagrees: plan says α ∈ {0.01, 0.05, 0.10}; tasks use {0.01, 0.02, 0.025, 0.05, 0.075, 0.10}. The finer grid is a superset (not a weakening), but the plan should be updated to match so FR-008's 'range of small values' has one authoritative definition.
